sections.title: Decisions requiring review
sections.sql: select external_id,student,rule,finding from v_compliance order by external_id,rule
sections.note: Evidence checks for staff review. No automatic government reporting.

sections.title: Enrolments
sections.sql: select external_id,student,intake,progress,open_cases from v_enrolments order by external_id

sections.title: Recorded attendance
sections.sql: select external_id,student,intake,scheduled_days,marked_days,marked_percent,coverage from v_attendance order by external_id
sections.note: Percentage covers marked sessions only. Check register coverage and the full approved timetable before drawing conclusions.

sections.title: Outstanding invoices
sections.sql: select external_id,student,due_on,currency,amount_cents,paid_cents,balance_cents from v_balances where balance_cents>0 order by currency,due_on
sections.note: Recorded invoice balances, not a tax ledger or payment service.
